 António Emanuel Carvalho Nobre, born on November 24, 1988 in Caldas da Rainha, Portugal, is a 36-year-old Portuguese football referee. Affiliated with the Leiria Football Association, he started his refereeing career in 2011 and made his Primeira Liga debut on August 19, 2017. Since 2019, he has been part of the FIFA referees panel, allowing him to officiate important international matches. In the 2024/2025 season, Nobre has been appointed to referee key matches in European and national competitions. His refereeing style is characterized by consistent application of the rules and effective communication with players, enabling him to maintain control during matches. This reputation has led him to be considered for high-profile matches in European competitions.
